clusters.label: LLM Agent Evaluation

clusters.label: Optimization and Quantization Techniques
clusters.description: These papers address methods for improving computational efficiency, precision, and reconstruction quality through techniques like hyperparameter optimization, quantization, compression, and denoising in deep learning models.

clusters.label: Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning
clusters.description: These papers address reinforcement learning and policy optimization in mean-field game settings, population-based systems, and continuous-time/continuous-space environments with robustness and convergence guarantees.

clusters.label: AI System Evaluation Frameworks
clusters.description: These papers present benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and systematic assessments of AI systems' performance on specialized tasks including legal reasoning, mathematical problem-solving, statistical analysis, and scientific discovery.

clusters.label: Neural Network Learning Dynamics
clusters.description: Papers exploring how neural networks learn, adapt, and perform under various conditions including input corruption, distribution shifts, and complex spatio-temporal data patterns.

clusters.label: Physics-Informed Neural Surrogates
clusters.description: These papers develop neural network-based surrogate models that incorporate physics constraints and domain-specific information to accelerate computational simulations and field reconstruction across various engineering applications.

clusters.label: Neural Operators for PDEs
clusters.description: Papers developing neural network architectures and learning methods for solving forward and inverse partial differential equations with applications to scientific computing and surrogate modeling.

clusters.label: Generative World Models for Autonomous Driving
clusters.description: These papers develop generative and diffusion-based world models that predict future scenarios, control vehicle behavior, and generate synthetic driving scenarios for autonomous vehicles and robotics.

clusters.label: Reliability and Robustness Assessment
clusters.description: These papers address methods for evaluating, calibrating, and assessing the reliability of AI systems, detection models, and automated scoring mechanisms under various conditions including distribution shifts and adversarial scenarios.

clusters.label: LLM Architecture and Efficiency
clusters.description: These papers explore innovations in language model design, including memory mechanisms, parameter efficiency, embeddings, and attention patterns to improve context handling and computational performance.

clusters.label: Mean-Field Methods in Machine Learning
clusters.description: These papers study mean-field theory, particle systems, and related mathematical frameworks for understanding neural networks, data selection, and optimization dynamics.

clusters.label: NLP System Evaluation and Detection
clusters.description: These papers examine the reliability, robustness, and detection of NLP and language model outputs across various applications including extraction, text generation, and resource-constrained settings.
